correctness.rationale: The complete 16-vertex Q4 total-three-cut face set contains 64,670 nonempty faces. The deterministic 32,270-pair discrete Morse matching has exactly one critical vertex and 129 critical ten-simplices; the checker orients all 513,248 Hasse covers and exhaustively topologically sorts all nodes, establishing acyclicity. Forman yields a wedge of 129 ten-spheres integrally. Independent low-dimensional Alexander-dual face counts (16,120,352,376) and Euler characteristic give 129, and the full B4 character is computed by the Hopf trace formula and independently by the signed Alexander-dual Euler formula for each of 384 automorphisms. The conclusion is restricted to this finite graph; no extrapolation is involved.

value.rationale: Q4 is a canonical symmetric 4-dimensional cube graph, not an arbitrary parameter choice. The exact integral homotopy type and non-shellability give structural information absent from the inspected graph-family theorems; the rational character across all 20 signed-cycle classes of B4 refines numerical homology and is useful for comparison with symmetry of other graph complexes. Although finite and self-contained rather than uniform in dimension, the question is motivated by the source total-cut program and its natural Cartesian-product setting.
